name: Elasticsearch Connector Ngram analyzer
description: Adds an n-gram analyzer and a 'Text Ngram' Search API data type to Elasticsearch Connector indexes for partial/substring matching.
project_description: Extends the Elasticsearch Connector module with an n-gram (3-gram) analyzer so Search API indexes can match partial words and substrings. It registers an ElasticSearchAnalyser plugin ('ngram_analyzer') and a Search API data type ('Text Ngram', id text_ngram). Event subscribers inject the analyzer/tokenizer into the index settings, map any text_ngram field to an Elasticsearch text field using the ngram analyzer (with a keyword sub-field), and normalise search query strings. No config forms, routes, permissions, or Drush commands are provided; you enable it per field by selecting the Text Ngram type in the Search API index Fields tab and reindexing.
